# ImageEditify

> ImageEditify is a free, browser-based photo editor. Crop, resize, rotate, apply filters, remove backgrounds, compress images, add watermarks and convert formats — fast, private and 100% free. No uploads, no account, no watermarks.

## Core Tools

- [Photo Editor](https://imageeditify.com/tool/photo-editor): The complete editing studio with filters, text, adjustment tools and live rendering.
- [Resize Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/resize-image): Scale to precise pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio locking and presets for HD, Full HD and web.
- [Crop Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/crop-image): Drag a live selection to cut your photo to pixel-perfect framing.
- [Rotate Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/rotate-image): Rotate in clean 90° steps and flip horizontally or vertically.
- [Compress Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/compress-image): Instantly shrink JPG file size with aggressive compression.
- [Upscale Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/upscale): Enlarge photos 2x with high-quality smoothing for prints and retina displays.
- [Remove Background](https://imageeditify.com/tool/remove-background): One-tap AI cutout that erases backgrounds in seconds, fully on-device.
- [Watermark Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/watermark-image): Brand photos with custom text watermarks — size, opacity, color and placement.
- [Blur Face](https://imageeditify.com/tool/blur-face): Paint over faces, plates or details with an adjustable blur brush.
- [Meme Generator](https://imageeditify.com/tool/meme-generator): Drop an image, add bold top and bottom text and export a share-ready meme.
- [HTML to Image](https://imageeditify.com/tool/html-to-image): Paste HTML with inline styles, preview live and export a crisp PNG snapshot.

## Image Conversion

- [Convert to JPG](https://imageeditify.com/tool/convert-to-jpg): Turn PNG or WEBP images into universally supported JPG files.
- [Convert from JPG](https://imageeditify.com/tool/convert-from-jpg): Re-encode JPGs into lossless PNG with full transparency support.

## Apps

- [Online Photo Editor](https://imageeditify.com/editor): Launch the full browser-based photo editing workspace.
